name: CarbonDate web page age estimator
operator: Old Dominion University, Web Science and Digital Libraries Research Group (WS-DL)
tier_rationale: Academic research service of a US university research group (A8 trusted: academic institutions); P059 'All archives are established non-profits or public bodies: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: An estimate combining archives, search engines and HTTP headers; answered with every source empty for well-known sites on 2026-11-26.

carbondate.title: CarbonDate /cd/{uri} creation-date estimate

terms.quote: Registry terms (A1 BR3): the Internet Archive (Wayback CDX and availability), Arquivo.pt (FCT public service), Common Crawl (free terms of use) and CarbonDate (ODU academic service) are 'open', each recorded by legal with evidence

carbondate.notes: Quote: binding council text (P059 cond 10). CarbonDate may read the live URI (last-modified, pubdate), so the provider is flagged fetches_target and never receives URLs carrying tokens, query strings or recipient identifiers (P059 cond 3). Deep/-M only (module web_archives_deep, default off). Research C0180: academic service, slow (~5.5 s), one request at a time; the scheme-less path cd/{host}{path} is used because the server merges '//'.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G01-2 (P059 cond 3, module web_archives_deep). One request at a time, 10 s apart, 7-day cache.
